source_conflicts.evidence_context: Table 2 and Results text support Temporin 1Sa amastigote ED50 as 42 (35-44) µM; a later conclusion sentence appears to cite 49 µM. The row-level artifact preserves the table value and records this as a nonblocking source inconsistency.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Table 2 and Results text support Temporin 1Sa amastigote ED50 as 42 (35-44) µM; a later conclusion sentence appears to cite 49 µM. The row-level artifact preserves the table value and records this as a nonblocking source inconsistency.
Local XML/PDF/supplement support parasite viability ED50 rows but do not report host-cell toxicity or hemolysis rows for this paper; no toxicity values were fabricated.
